name: Fatigue
body:
Discipline: psychometabolism; Level soulthief 0

MANIFESTING

Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Display: mental

EFFECT

Range: 30 ft.
Target: 1 living creature
Duration: 1 round/lvl.
Saving Throw: Fort negates; Power Resistance: yes
Power Points: psionic focus or 1

DESCRIPTION

As a ranged touch attack, you may cause a target to be fatigued for a number of rounds equal to your manifester level. A successful Fortitude save negates this effect. This ability has no effect on a creature that is already fatigued.
